concern_summary: This concern encompasses functionalities related to the user interaction with tabs, including the management of active states, selection of tabs, navigation behaviors, and visual feedback for tab activities.

This concern focuses on managing the user's navigation experience through scroll offsets and the maintenance of the selected tab state, ensuring that users can effectively navigate between different application views.
This concern is dedicated to managing the presence and status of the Chat Tab, based on specific indicators tied to policy reports.

This concern is centered around the Bottom Tab Navigator, which handles the configuration and display of various bottom tabs, integrating user details and providing navigation across essential application sections.
This concern relates to the Bottom Search Tab, which manages search-related functionalities and navigation transitions, enhancing user search capabilities within the tabbed interface.
This concern pertains to the presentation of tabs in the user interface, including the rendering of content associated with tabs, such as labels and icons, to enhance the visual experience.
